audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields (whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1]) were built on "Pantheon's Aegis Protection passive" giving him "a free auto-block" that Teemo should burn with autos and cancel with his blind.
audit.why: Aegis Protection is not in Pantheon's kit. His passive is Mortal Will — every few spells or attacks, his NEXT SPELL is empowered. There is no auto-block passive and nothing for the blind to cancel. The whole early-game gameplan in this entry was therefore aimed at a mechanic that is not in the game, and the real tell — Mortal Will stack count predicting an empowered Comet Spear — went unmentioned.
audit.corrected: Track Mortal Will stacks; the empowered spell is the burst. The damage-blocking tool is Aegis Assault (E), a 22s directional channel, not a passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault was described only as a "point-click stun"; its attack reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset as well as a dash and stun, so the burst arrives on the basic attack that follows the dash — and that attack is exactly what Blinding Dart erases. Blinding on the cast animation is too early; blinding as the dash connects is what blanks the combo.
audit.corrected: Blind as Shield Vault lands, not when he winds up — the reset attack is the part the blind removes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing; the full layer tracked only Shield Vault with the note "His all-in start. Blind + kite it."
audit.why: Aegis Assault is 22/21/20/19/18s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the only thing that stops Teemo's damage. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8s. The 22s number is what tells a Teemo player when an extended trade is actually free.
audit.corrected: Trade the moment Aegis Assault is down: 22s at rank 1 is the widest window in the matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q appeared as both "Blind Shot" (whys[0], whys[2], whys[3]) and "Blinding Shot" (spikes[0], spikes[1], wants.you[0]).
audit.why: Riot's name is Blinding Dart. This entry carried two different wrong spellings of the same ability.

edits.after: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will: every few casts or autos empowers his next spell. Count the stacks — the empowered Comet Spear is the one that hurts.

edits.before: Full kit online: Blind Shot erases his passive reset during the trade window and Toxic Shot DoT punishes the disengage — Pantheon cannot win extended poke.
edits.after: Full kit online: Aegis Assault blocks only what comes at his front, so step around the channel rather than backing straight off — he cannot win extended poke.

edits.after: Max-rank Blinding Dart with poison stacking hits its peak — he has no reliable gap-close through your Move Quick, and every trade he initiates is on your terms.

notes: ROOT CAUSE, and it is worth acting on beyond this matchup. There are TWO Pantheon kits on disk: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json (modern — Mortal Will / Comet Spear / Shield Vault / Aegis Assault / Grand Starfall) and champ-data/_kits/jadepantheon.json (id Jade_Pantheon — Aegis Protection / Spear Shot / Aegis of Zeonia / Heartseeker Strike / Grand Skyfall). This entry is keyed "b":"pantheon", so it faces the modern kit, but its early-game advice was written against Jade Pantheon's Aegis Protection passive. The two kits got crossed. The same bug exists elsewhere: champ-data/content/mid/fizz.js has an entry keyed "a":"fizz_mid","b":"pantheon" that also builds its gameplan on Aegis Protection ("Block your poke with Aegis Protection and counter-engage on the parry window", "Level 3 all-ins land clean whenever his Aegis Protection is on cooldown"). That one is outside my slice and still needs fixing. No entry anywhere uses "b":"jadepantheon", so Jade Pantheon currently has a kit file but no matchups pointing at it — which is probably how the mix-up went unnoticed. The suspect-name detector cannot catch this class of error, because Aegis Protection is a real ability name, just the wrong champion's.
